description: Weighs a public page from its delivered HTML. Pass `url`. Reports HTML bytes (uncompressed, plus the server's reported transfer length when given), element count, link count and distinct link targets, image count with lazy-loaded and no-dimension counts, iframes, media, inline style and script bytes, and the number and uncompressed size of linked stylesheets and scripts (up to 10 stylesheets and 20 subresources are fetched, each up to 3 MB). Warns on thousands of links, large HTML, large DOM, many images or scripts. Reads up to 5 MB of HTML; if it stops early it says so, states how many bytes it read and what share of the page that is when the size is known, and treats every count as a minimum. Does not run script, so content added at runtime, images, fonts and media sizes are not included.

url.description: A public page URL to fetch.

name: page_weight_report
title: Page weight report
